exposure: Combined treatment of McDonald cerclage and Arabin pessary
outcome: Preterm birth (<34 weeks, <28 weeks, <32 weeks, <37 weeks of gestation)
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 81 women with singleton pregnancies at increased risk for preterm birth due to cervical shortening and/or previous preterm delivery, who received either a McDonald cerclage or a combined treatment of cerclage and Arabin pessary.
finding: The combined treatment of cerclage with an Arabin pessary did not significantly reduce preterm birth rates compared to cerclage alone, but was associated with a shorter mean neonatal intensive care unit admission time and a trend towards higher birthweight.
birth_weight: Mean birthweights were 2368 g (cerclage group) and 2650 g (combined treatment group).
